changes.summary: A new service worker no longer counts as an app update when the server's newest release is the one the page already runs (a page loaded fresh during a deploy). With startAppUpdateChecks({ currentRelease }) running, the waiting worker takes over quietly: no onUpdateAvailable prompt and no auto-update reload. A genuinely newer release is still announced.

Apply app updates automatically at a safe moment with startAutoUpdate: immediately in hidden tabs, after an idle period in visible ones, never while a dialog is open, a field has focus or the app reports unsaved work
Allow retry after a failed app update activation lookup
Discover app updates in long-lived tabs
